title: Fuobe Evolution · change intensity and the written direction
description: Runs Video tools → Evolution (POST /api/evolution, priced by /api/evolution/estimate) on your clip and references in local/evolution/: walk.mp4 (4–30 s of someone walking, your own footage) and ref-1.png … ref-3.png (characters, places or a style you own; never Higgsfield previews). The Original (build plan O13) runs on both engines: on ComfyUI, a direction frame from Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 then Wan 2.2 Fun VACE from the noised segment at denoise 0.45 / 0.65 / 0.85; on fal, LTX-2.3 22B video to video at video_strength 0.55 / 0.35 / 0.15. The three intensity cases share a direction, so they show how much of the clip each keeps (temporal drift against the source, style against the references); the written case leaves the direction to the writer. Nothing here has been rendered yet: these cases decide the intensities' denoise values.
